name: seawall_stuns_near_holdfast
description: The Seawall bursts in a ring of radius_mm (3.0 m) around the seat's Holdfast (design 1.4): a Gourdling held 1 m from seat 2's Holdfast is stunned 120 ticks and loses 25% of its maximum health; a Bristlesow 2 m off loses 8% and is slowed 50% for those ticks instead, unshrunk by its control resistance, and is not stunned; a Gourdling 8 m up the road and one 1 m from seat 1's Holdfast are untouched. EV_SEAWALL says where it rose, its radius, the two it struck, the charges left and when it may rise again. In the window it is WRONG_PHASE; with no charge NO_CHARGE; with one but within the 900-tick cooldown SEAWALL_STANDING; after it, it rises again.

steps.msg: no Seawall in the window; the horn sounded

steps.eval: [scene.spawn('gourdling', end - 1000000, 1), scene.spawn('bristlesow', end - 2000000, 1), scene.spawn('gourdling', end - 8000000, 1), scene.spawn('gourdling', end - 1000000, 0)]

steps.msg: the near two stand in seat 2's ring, the far one outside it
it rose on seat 2's hollow, radius 3 m, struck two, no charge left, ready again in 900 ticks

steps.assert: scene.creep(ids[0]).stun_until == at + 120 and scene.creep(ids[0]).hp_c == hp[0] - hp[0] * 250 / 1000
steps.msg: the near Gourdling is stunned 2 s and lost a quarter of its health

steps.assert: scene.creep(ids[1]).stun_until == 0 and scene.creep(ids[1]).slow_pm == 500 and scene.creep(ids[1]).slow_until == at + 120 and scene.creep(ids[1]).hp_c == hp[1] - hp[1] * 80 / 1000
steps.msg: the Bristlesow is slowed 50% instead, and lost 8%

steps.assert: scene.creep(ids[2]).hp_c == hp[2] and scene.creep(ids[2]).stun_until == 0 and scene.creep(ids[3]).hp_c == hp[3] and scene.creep(ids[3]).stun_until == 0
steps.msg: the far one and seat 1's are untouched

steps.assert: scene.since(scene.refusal_ticks(2), at + 1).size() == 2 and scene.since(scene.refusal_ticks(2), at + 1)[0][1] == 'NO_CHARGE' and scene.since(scene.refusal_ticks(2), at + 1)[1][1] == 'SEAWALL_STANDING'
steps.msg: with no charge NO_CHARGE; with one within the cooldown SEAWALL_STANDING
after the cooldown it rises again
